status_note: Explicit-Varnode dynamic symbolization projection locked against the Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle: the ActionNameVars local-entry chain (hasName -> linkSymbol -> queryProperties -> handleSymbolConflict -> buildDynamicSymbol -> DynamicHash::uniqueHash -> addDynamicSymbol -> buildDefaultName/renameSymbol). 12/12 records byte-identical with zero source overlays (the committed base e9baabd already carries the faithful chain). The E2E uVar_<offset> GLUE residual that motivated this fixture is NOT a missing varmap path: it is blocked upstream of linkSymbol by merge-domain mixed implied/explicit highs (see residual merge_mixed_high_e2e).

analysis_options.api: Direct ActionNameVars::perform/apply invocation over a synthetic per-case Funcdata body; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.debug_macros: OPACTION_DEBUG and CPUI_DEBUG are absent; the fixture's #define private public access shim only exposes Varnode::setFlags
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory and the model-windowed ScopeLocal; each Ghidra case clears prior state via fd.clear(). Rugra builds an isolated synthetic Funcdata per case whose ScopeLocal carries the same cspec localrange window.
analysis_options.ir: Register-space temporaries written by COPY(const) ops at explicit code addresses, each with a unique-space reader COPY; all ops inserted into live basic blocks so they register in the address-keyed op tree.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: buildDynamicSymbol (funcdata_varnode.cc:1283-1306) passes high->getType() BY POINTER into Scope::addDynamicSymbol (database.cc:1690) whose returned Symbol* is attached to the varnode via sym->getFirstWholeMap() — the SymbolEntry is shared state, not a copy; linkSymbol (funcdata_varnode.cc:1156-1189) passes fl by reference into queryProperties but has no consumer; handleSymbolConflict returns entry->getSymbol() for the attach legs and vn->getSymbolEntry()->getSymbol() for the dynamic leg.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: linkSymbols (coreaction.cc:2947-2974) walks every non-constant space in space-manager order, then the VarnodeLocSet in (location, definition) order — the varnode creation order breaks ties at one storage, so the earlier-defined temp receives the static Symbol and the later one the dynamic Symbol; handleSymbolConflict's conflict scan (cc:1005-1020) walks beginLoc(entry size/addr) and breaks at the first (size, addr) mismatch or foreign high; ActionMarkImplied ordering (markimplied BEFORE the merge family, cc:5720) governs which instances carry implied flags into namevars.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: One shared int4 base=1 per function spans the whole naming loop (coreaction.cc:2987-2997) — the unique-space readers consume Var1/Var2 before the register temporaries consume Var3/Var4 (loc-tree order), the same counter feeds buildDefaultName for static and dynamic symbols alike, and assignDefaultNames reuses it afterwards; buildUndefinedName's $$undefXXXXXXXX counter is per-scope and monotonic.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: ScopeInternal::buildVariableName's local branch (database.cc:2499-2515) compares the candidate printNameBase+Var+index string against the nametree via findFirstByName, bumping the index up to 10 times before makeNameUnique; makeNameUnique (database.cc:2553-2614) scans symbols sharing the name prefix and increments the parsed _NN/_xNNNNN suffix id; the loc-set comparator is (space, offset, size, input/written/free class, definition).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-varmap-dynamicsym-base-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

explicit_conflict_dynamic.covers: linkSymbol conflict leg -> handleSymbolConflict foreign-high walk -> buildDynamicSymbol (uniqueHash methods 0-3, champion dedup) -> Scope::addDynamicSymbol ($$undef name, dynamic map, single-address uselimit) -> namerec -> buildDefaultName vn path -> ScopeInternal::buildVariableName local branch -> renameSymbol (uVar4); varnode setSymbolEntry mapped flag

separate_usepoints_two_statics.covers: queryProperties single-point uselimit gate: two static Symbols at one storage with distinct usepoints; Scope::addSymbol at the register address with the def-op usepoint

implied_conflict_rejected.covers: HighVariable::hasName implied member rejection (variable.cc:729-733) upstream of linkSymbol: the implied high stays symbolless and unmapped over a conflicting storage — implied semantics untouched

illegal_input_attach.covers: handleSymbolConflict isInput leg (funcdata_varnode.cc:1000-1003): the input attaches to the pre-existing unlimited-use Symbol; no dynamic Symbol; setSymbolEntry sets mapped

spacebase_input_rejected.covers: hasName unaffected+spacebase rejection (variable.cc:737-745): no link, no symbol, scope empty

addrtied_attach_conflict.covers: handleSymbolConflict isAddrTied leg: both address-tied highs attach to one ranged stack Symbol; ScopeLocal::buildVariableName Stack branch names it iStack_c0 through the cspec localrange window

branches.detail: ActionDynamicSymbols (coreaction.cc:4869, attemptDynamicMappingLate) is a registered stub in Rugra (action.rs :5724/:5733): mapping pre-existing dynamic symbols onto varnodes across the two deliberate instances is unproven; no production corpus path creates database-loaded dynamic symbols, so the fixture cannot exercise it from ActionNameVars alone.

buildDynamicSymbol's constant leg (addEquateSymbol, funcdata_varnode.cc:1300-1301) is unreachable through the ActionNameVars projection: constant-space varnodes only reach linkSymbol when they already hold a SymbolEntry (coreaction.cc:2938-2944), and constants with different values never overlap one storage address.

The E2E printc uVar_<offset> GLUE residual (6 curl functions, backfill injection group) is NOT a varmap gap: the explicit representative's high carries mixed implied+explicit instances (e.g. my_get_token unique+0x23b00: 15 instances, 3 implied), so hasName rejects it before linkSymbol. Oracle order markimplied(:5720) < mergetype(:5727) is registered correctly in Rugra, but ActionMergeRequired/mergeOp force-merges same-slot instances into one high and Rugra's check_implied_cover approximation (static aggregate cover) then marks a MIX where Ghidra's inflateTest cover model marks whole merged highs explicit — in Ghidra the mixed state is unreachable (hasName would throw LowlevelError 'Implied varnode has been merged'). Fix domain: merge.rs inflate_test / coreaction.rs check_implied_cover (merge/cover lease).

Funcdata::newVarnode's setVarnodeProperties scope-ownership query (funcdata_varnode.cc:26-42) sets the mapped bit at creation for stack-window varnodes; Rugra's set_varnode_properties consults the flat symbol_table instead of ScopeLocal queryProperties. The BEFORE stage of the fixture projection omits the varnode flag section for exactly this reason; the AFTER-stage mapped bits match through setSymbolEntry.
